headline: Spain Withholds 188,000 Tonnes of Olive Oil Supply to Support Producer Prices
summary: Spain is withholding 12% of its olive oil output, taking roughly 188,000 tonnes off the market through September 2027 to prevent further declines in wholesale prices.
why: Spain is the world's largest producer of olive oil; supply interventions directly set benchmark international wholesale prices.

impacts.name: Olive Oil Wholesale Benchmark
impacts.why: Withholding 188,000 tonnes from circulation restricts market liquidity to floor falling prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Supply curtailment policies enacted by Spain boosted agricultural commodity price expectations.
